description: A multi-tab admin dashboard for a myConnect community you administer — pick which one from the dropdown if you administer more than one. Analytics (live): pick a date range to see total sign-ups, a completed/pending/declined breakdown with percent change vs. the previous period, and a month-by-month trend table you can click into for a popup of that month's members. Members (live): every member of the community, name/email/last seen at a glance — click a name for status, tags, role, join date and access groups. Event RSVP's (live): a featured card for the next upcoming event, an upcoming/past event list — click an event for a popup of its RSVPs (member, email, status, sessions, attended, business name, industry) with a print report. The other tabs (Access Groups, Community Feed, Notifications) are coming in later iterations.

props.text: A multi-tab admin dashboard for a myConnect community you administer. The community picker only appears if you administer more than one — otherwise it's just yours. Being built incrementally — Analytics and Members are live so far.

To defaults to today; pick a From date and press "Show sign-ups" to see the total who joined your community in that range (inclusive, based on when their membership was created), plus how many of them are now active (Completed joining), still invited (Pending), or deactivated (Declined / inactive) — each shown as a count and its share of the total, with a percent change against the immediately preceding period of the same length. Press "Print report" for a printable summary of the same figures. Press "Show trend" for a month-by-month table of the same range — click any month row to open a popup listing the members who joined that month (name, joined date, tags and status).
